changelog:
Initial release of the SAR Analysis skill providing SciMiner-based SAR workflows and binding-mode predictions.

- Adds MCS-based SAR, scaffold-based SAR, and target-aware binding-mode prediction using SciMiner and AlphaFold3 APIs.
- Supports both file and inline table inputs; guides method selection based on analysis needs and series diversity.
- Implements a detailed binding-mode workflow: PDB search, template extraction, AlphaFold3 prediction, Gnina scoring, and correlation to activity.
- Strictly requires reading up-to-date Markdown tool docs for all invocations; enforces parameter validation and API conformity.
- API key handling is documented and required via external credential file—skill will prompt if missing.
summary: Structure-activity relationship analysis workflows using SciMiner's MCS-based and scaffold-based SAR APIs for file or inline table inputs, plus an AlphaFold3-based binding-mode prediction workflow for target-aware SAR.
